ModMetaData.name: Hacking Expansion: Netrun
ModMetaData.author: Raul Moreau
ModMetaData.description:
A cyberpunk layer for Ushanka's Hacking Expansion. Every intrusion leaves a digital trace, and the net always answers.
• Network terminal: a node map on the comms console (renamed to network console) and in the cyberpod: Core, Club, Board, Archive, Server room, Studio, Gateway. • Digital Heat: five levels from Shadow to Red Zone, network attacks and a hidden mercenary faction that follows your trace. • Fixers and contracts: calls, trace scrubbing, a shop, reputation, data deliveries and system taps. • Networked AIs: awaken fragments, keep them on the AI server, in a cyberpod coprocessor or in a colonist's AI socket. 13 personalities with services, hunger, trust, requests and 75 events. • Cyberspace: dive into external nodes from a cyberpod, turn by turn, with programs, code gates and Black ICE. • Braindance: goggles record strong moments, edit them into chips, mind the addiction.
Requires Hacking Expansion, Harmony and Vanilla Expanded Framework. Russian and English.
Киберпанк-дополнение к Hacking Expansion: сетевой терминал, цифровой след, фиксеры и контракты, сетевые ИИ, нырки в киберпространство и брейнданс. Перевод на русский язык включён.
